items.text: A refactor must keep observable behavior identical. Run the same differential repro at base and head for each moved or rewritten code path; any difference in output, exceptions or side effects is a finding.
Check argument and field order at every call site the refactor rewrote, and that removed parameters (including **kwargs) were really unused: Grep the instantiation and call sites.
Check that defaults, keyword names, public names and import paths that callers outside the package may rely on still exist and behave the same.
